scope: Execute the implemented exact one-step checkpoint/resume qualification before the official 100M-frame public reproduction; no capability claim

procedure: run the official multi/stateful=false contract to an instrumented learner-update boundary
preserve the complete official job.tar and pre-update model, actor-model, optimizer, scheduler, frame and RNG state

preserve all partial evidence and the exact failed comparison if any equality check fails

Python, NumPy and Torch RNG states

checkpoint and payload bytes and SHA-256
